description:
Assess retained module observations without executing code or changing task state.

Registry: corpus/evidence-index.json = {schema: 1, receipts: [{path, sha256}]}.
Receipt paths must be relative JSON files below corpus/receipts; every referenced
file is relative to code_root, regular, and reached without following symlinks.

Strict receipt fields: schema=1, receipt_id, module_id, kind (testing, hardening,
deployment), source_kind="engine_source", observed_at (timezone-bearing ISO 8601),
subject_files={relative_path: sha256}, acceptance={task_id: sha256 of exact UTF-8
acceptance text}, mandatory_checks=[check_id], checks=[{id, outcome, executed,
skipped, log: {path, sha256}}]. All declared mandatory checks must occur once,
pass, execute a positive number of cases and skip none. The module's primary
stub_path must belong to the subject and contain non-comment body outside the
HEE3-ANCHORS-BEGIN/END block. Body presence is not proof of implementation.

Hardening additionally requires hardening={threat_model: file_ref, findings:
[{id, disposition: "fixed"|"accepted_limitation", authority, evidence:file_ref}]}.
An explicit empty findings list records the producer's no-findings claim.
Deployment additionally requires deployment={environment, installed_artifact:
{path,sha256}, installed_config:{path,sha256}, readback:file_ref}. Installed paths
are absolute identity labels, never opened by this helper. Hashed readback JSON
must contain exactly schema=1, environment, installed_artifact, installed_config,
observed_at, outcome="pass" matching the receipt's declared identities and time.

Missing files are unavailable; changed bytes or acceptance are stale; incomplete
or non-qualifying claims are unqualified. Current_observation means consistency
with the declared subject only, not authenticated origin, runtime certification,
or task acceptance. The newest observation per kind controls its summary; ties
fail conservatively. Unattributable registry entries prevent a current summary.
All historical claims remain in evidence. assess snapshots an aware assessment
cutoff (current UTC by default, or an injected as_of datetime). Future-dated
observations are unqualified. No age expiry or current-health claim is inferred.
assessment_time_policy: assess(..., as_of=aware_datetime) optionally injects a timezone-aware cutoff; default current UTC is captured once. Future observations are unqualified and retained. The cutoff is omitted from the returned module model. No age expiry or current-health claim is inferred.
authority: Observations never edit atlas task state or confer acceptance/deployment authority.
